In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''tetrahedral-square tiling honeycomb''' is a [[paracompact uniform honeycomb]], constructed from [[tetrahedron]], [[cuboctahedron]] and  [[square tiling]] cells, in a [[rhombicuboctahedron]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a single-ring [[Coxeter diagram]], {{CDD|node|split1-44|nodes_10luru|split2|node}}, and is named by its two regular cells.

{{Honeycomb}}
{{Clear}}

The '''cyclotruncated tetrahedral-square tiling honeycomb''' is a [[paracompact uniform honeycomb]], constructed from [[tetrahedron]], [[cube]], [[truncated cube]] and  [[truncated square tiling]] cells, in a [[triangular antiprism]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|node_1|split1-44|nodes_10luru|split2|node}}.
